# PDForo

> PDForo is a free, fast, privacy-friendly online PDF toolkit. Every tool runs
> on our own servers — files are processed and returned in seconds, then
> deleted. No signup required to use the free tier.

PDForo lets anyone merge, split, compress, convert, edit, and secure PDF and
image files directly in the browser. It is a modern alternative to iLovePDF and
Smallpdf, priced below both, with a generous free tier.

## Tools

- [Merge PDF](/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one file, in any order.
- [Split PDF](/tools/split-pdf): Extract a page range or split a PDF every N pages.
- [Compress PDF](/tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size while keeping quality.
- [JPG to PDF](/tools/jpg-to-pdf): Turn one or more images into a single PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Convert each PDF page into a high-quality JPG.
- [PDF to Word](/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert a PDF into an editable Word (DOCX) document.
- [Word to PDF](/tools/word-to-pdf): Convert a Word document to PDF.
- [PDF to Excel](/tools/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables from a PDF into an Excel spreadsheet.
- [Excel to PDF](/tools/excel-to-pdf): Convert a spreadsheet to PDF.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](/tools/ppt-to-pdf): Convert a slide deck to PDF.
- [Watermark PDF](/tools/watermark-pdf): Add a text watermark to every page.
- [Protect PDF](/tools/protect-pdf): Password-protect (encrypt) a PDF.
- [Unlock PDF](/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove a known password from a PDF.
- [Background Remover](/tools/remove-background): Remove the background from any photo using AI.

## Pricing

- Free: $0 — core tools, up to 10 MB per file, 2 files per batch (ad-supported).
- Pro: $8.49/mo or $71/yr — 200 MB files, 50 per batch, ad-free, no watermark, priority.
- Ultra Pro: $14.99/mo or $125/yr — 1 GB files, 200 per batch, highest limits, top priority.

## Notes

- Files are processed server-side and not stored longer than needed.
- The free tier requires no account. Sign in (Google or email) to upgrade.
- Learn more: [Pricing](/pricing)
